question: The value of (5)/(14) times (14)/(frac{7){5} div (7)/(11) { of } 2(1)/(5)} is :
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cancel first: (5/14 × 14) = 5

Convert mixed number: 2 1/5 = 11/5

Inside: (7/5) ÷ (7/11 × 11/5) = (7/5) ÷ (7/5) = 1

So expression = 5 ÷ 1

**∴ Answer = 5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(5/14) × 14 ÷ [(7/5) ÷ (7/11) of 2 1/5]

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ (5/14) × 14 ÷ [(7/5) ÷ (7/11) × 11/5]

⇒ (5/14) × 14 ÷ [(7/5) ÷ (77/55)]

⇒ (5/14) × 14 ÷ [(7/5) ÷ (7/5)]

⇒ (5/14) × 14 ÷ 1

⇒ 5 ÷ 1

⇒ 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Brackets → Orders → Division/Multiplication → Addition/Subtraction

Of Means Multiply

In such expressions, of is treated as multiplication.

Fraction Division

a/b ÷ c/d = a/b × d/c

Mixed Fraction

Convert mixed numbers into improper fractions before solving.
